whyAppriyo.label: // 04 — why us
whyAppriyo.heading: Small team. Direct access. No middlemen.
whyAppriyo.paragraph: You talk directly to the person building your system — not a account manager relaying messages to a developer you'll never meet. We're a small team of four, and we intend to still be answering your calls after you've forgotten you ever used a notebook.
whyAppriyo.statsEmpty: No stats will be shown here until real numbers are confirmed.
